admission.justification: The same owner-wait rule is realized in the change-set conditional store and the task-body store, and the read-ownership and mounted task-switch cases guard both facets.

applicability: Dashboard shared reads with per-owner AbortSignals: change-set list/file, changed-intent summary and task body.
conditions: A same-key reader that did not leave receives the shared fetch/result.
The last waiter's leave removes the pending entry before its request is aborted.
A later read starts a new fetch, never the aborted one; an aborted read is not rendered as a failure or retained as an error.
exclusions: Completed retained bodies/counters across navigation, different-facts reads and non-dashboard callers.
statement: A shared dashboard read's owner cancellation ends only that owner's wait: a live same-key reader keeps its result, and the entry is forgotten at the last leave so a replacement starts a fresh request.
